subject: [PATCH v2 17/17] selftests/mm: zap whole PTE tables in the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged race harness to occasionally zap a whole PMD-aligned area of pages, rather than just individual pages or tables. This is done to test the empty-table reclaim functionality, which only engages when a zap spans an entire table. The change introduces occasional whole-table zaps every 64 iterations, while maintaining the existing fine-grained page zapping as the common case.
